name: de-eli-mcp
description: German federal law with verifiable citations: legislation from the federal legal information portal (NeuRIS, ELI identifiers, real text), case law at all court levels (rechtsprechung-im-internet.de and Open Legal Data, ECLI) and Bundestag parliamentary documents (DIP). Every answer carries the official source and identifier, so a citation can be checked instead of trusted. Queries go only to these public German sources; nothing goes to MateMatic.
